# hip_native: hip bracket of the Frankenduck leg (hip_l.001 left / hip_l.002 right).
# L bracket joining the hip-roll servo horn (X plate) and the hip-pitch servo horn (Y plate).
# Native rebuild of the Blender mesh, robot world frame, mm, Z up. Dimensions measured from
# the mesh (sections, circle fits). The right part is the exact mirror about Y = 0.
import math
import cadquery as cq

SIDE = 1  # +1 left (hip_l.001, +Y), -1 right (hip_l.002, mirror about Y = 0)
z0 = 87.55  # mm Plate bottom
z1 = 113.2  # mm Plate top
end_r = 12.825  # mm Plate round end radius (half the plate height)
edge_r = 0.9  # mm Plate perimeter edge round
# Y plate (hip-pitch horn, axis along Y)
ya_x = 5.4  # mm Y-plate horn axis X
ya_z = 100.375  # mm Horn axis Z (both plates)
yp0 = 45.9  # mm Y plate inner face
yp1 = 51.3  # mm Y plate outer face
y_horn = 51.975  # mm Y-plate horn face (pad top)
# X plate (hip-roll horn, axis along X)
xa_y = 23.625  # mm X-plate horn axis Y
x_horn = 30.375  # mm X-plate horn face (pad top)
xp0 = 31.05  # mm X plate inner face
xp1 = 36.45  # mm X plate outer face at the horn
xp1c = 34.425  # mm X plate outer face near the corner
# corner (XY)
in_cx = 22.95  # mm Inner corner arc centre X
in_cy = 37.8  # mm Inner corner arc centre Y
in_r = 8.1  # mm Inner corner arc radius
out_cx = 23.625  # mm Outer corner arc centre X
out_cy = 40.5  # mm Outer corner arc centre Y
out_r = 10.8  # mm Outer corner arc radius
s_cc = (43.79, 40.155)  # mm Thinning step: concave arc centre (XY)
s_cr = 9.37  # mm Thinning step: concave arc radius
s_vr = 20.5  # mm Thinning step: convex arc radius
# horn pads
pad_r0 = 12.75  # mm Pad radius at the horn face
pad_r1 = 15.65  # mm Pad radius where it meets the plate
# outer bar
bar_z0 = 93.67  # mm Bar bottom
bar_z1 = 107.08  # mm Bar top
bar_x1 = 39.15  # mm Bar outer face
bar_cr = 6.75  # mm Bar outer corner radius (XY)
bar_base_x = 34.425  # mm Bar taper start X
bar_base_hw = 8.0  # mm Bar half height at the taper start
bar_taper = 20.0  # deg Bar side draft
bar_edge_r = 0.9  # mm Bar outer edge round
bar_fil_r = 3.5  # mm Bar-to-body blend radius in the corner
bar_fil_r2 = 0.8  # mm Bar-to-plate blend radius on the X plate
# horn holes
bolt_r = 7.0  # mm Horn screw bolt-circle radius
hole_r = 1.7  # mm M3 clearance radius
rec_r = 3.2  # mm Horn hub recess radius
rec_d = 3.2  # mm Horn hub recess depth from the horn face
cb_r = 3.4  # mm Counterbore radius
x_cb = 34.375  # mm X-plate counterbore floor
y_cb = 47.975  # mm Y-plate counterbore floor

BIG = 200.0


def arc_pt(c, r, ang):
    return (c[0] + r * math.cos(ang), c[1] + r * math.sin(ang))


# --- full-height L body -------------------------------------------------------------
# thinning step: convex arc tangent to x = xp1, concave arc tangent to x = xp1c
vc = (xp1 - s_vr, None)
dx = s_cc[0] - vc[0]
dy = math.sqrt((s_cr + s_vr) ** 2 - dx ** 2)
vc = (vc[0], s_cc[1] - dy)
ang = math.atan2(s_cc[1] - vc[1], s_cc[0] - vc[0])
t_pt = arc_pt(vc, s_vr, ang)  # tangent point between the two arcs
L = (cq.Workplane("XY", origin=(0, 0, z0)).moveTo(-20, yp0).lineTo(in_cx, yp0)
     .threePointArc(arc_pt((in_cx, in_cy), in_r, math.radians(45)), (in_cx + in_r, in_cy))
     .lineTo(xp0, 0).lineTo(xp1, 0).lineTo(xp1, vc[1])
     .threePointArc(arc_pt(vc, s_vr, ang / 2), t_pt)
     .threePointArc(arc_pt(s_cc, s_cr, (math.pi + ang + math.pi) / 2), (xp1c, s_cc[1]))
     .lineTo(xp1c, out_cy)
     .threePointArc(arc_pt((out_cx, out_cy), out_r, math.radians(45)), (out_cx, yp1))
     .lineTo(-20, yp1).close().extrude(z1 - z0))
ystad = (cq.Workplane("XZ", origin=(0, 80, 0)).moveTo(ya_x, z0).lineTo(BIG, z0).lineTo(BIG, z1)
         .lineTo(ya_x, z1).threePointArc((ya_x - end_r, ya_z), (ya_x, z0)).close().extrude(100))
xstad = (cq.Workplane("YZ", origin=(-30, 0, 0)).moveTo(xa_y, z0).lineTo(BIG, z0).lineTo(BIG, z1)
         .lineTo(xa_y, z1).threePointArc((xa_y - end_r, ya_z), (xa_y, z0)).close().extrude(100))
body = L.intersect(ystad).intersect(xstad)


def under_pad(e):
    # plate edges covered by a horn pad stay sharp (the pad sits flush with the plate end)
    pts = [e.positionAt(t) for t in (0.0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0)]
    on_x = all(abs(p.x - xp0) < 1e-3 and math.hypot(p.y - xa_y, p.z - ya_z) < pad_r1 for p in pts)
    on_y = all(abs(p.y - yp1) < 1e-3 and math.hypot(p.x - ya_x, p.z - ya_z) < pad_r1 for p in pts)
    on_pad = all(math.hypot(p.y - xa_y, p.z - ya_z) < pad_r1 + 0.01 and x_horn - 1e-3 < p.x < xp0 + 1e-3 for p in pts) or \
        all(math.hypot(p.x - ya_x, p.z - ya_z) < pad_r1 + 0.01 and yp1 - 1e-3 < p.y < y_horn + 1e-3 for p in pts)
    return on_x or on_y or on_pad


s_body = body.val()
body = cq.Workplane().add(s_body.fillet(edge_r, [e for e in s_body.Edges() if not under_pad(e)]))

# --- outer bar ------------------------------------------------------------------------
# outline: outer edge plus an inner return that stays inside the full-height body
def bar_outline():
    return (cq.Workplane("XY", origin=(0, 0, bar_z0)).moveTo(out_cx, 47.5).lineTo(out_cx, yp1).lineTo(bar_x1 - bar_cr, yp1)
       .threePointArc(arc_pt((bar_x1 - bar_cr, yp1 - bar_cr), bar_cr, math.radians(45)), (bar_x1, yp1 - bar_cr))
       .lineTo(bar_x1, 5).lineTo(34.2, 5).lineTo(34.2, 38.5).lineTo(31.5, 44).lineTo(27, 47.5).close())


bar = bar_outline().extrude(bar_z1 - bar_z0)
tap = (cq.Workplane("YZ", origin=(bar_base_x, 0, 0)).moveTo(xa_y, ya_z - bar_base_hw).lineTo(80, ya_z - bar_base_hw)
       .lineTo(80, ya_z + bar_base_hw).lineTo(xa_y, ya_z + bar_base_hw)
       .threePointArc((xa_y - bar_base_hw, ya_z), (xa_y, ya_z - bar_base_hw)).close()
       .extrude(bar_x1 - bar_base_x + 0.5, taper=bar_taper))
tap = tap.union(cq.Workplane("XY").box(20, 50, 40, centered=(False, False, True)).translate((bar_base_x - 20 + 1e-3, 30, ya_z)))
bar = bar.intersect(tap)
bar = bar.faces(">X").edges().fillet(bar_edge_r)
body = body.union(bar)

# bar-to-body blends. On the X plate face (x = xp1) an OCC fillet of radius bar_fil_r2.
# Around the corner an explicit fillet solid of radius bar_fil_r, built per path element
# (revolved about each arc's axis, extruded along the line) and clipped to the bar outline.
from OCP.BRepFilletAPI import BRepFilletAPI_MakeFillet

bar_xy = bar_outline().extrude(bar_z1 - bar_z0 + 2 * bar_fil_r + 2).translate((0, 0, -bar_fil_r - 1))
s0 = body.val()
mk = BRepFilletAPI_MakeFillet(s0.wrapped)
for e in s0.Edges():
    pts = [e.positionAt(t) for t in (0.0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0)]
    if all(abs(p.x - xp1) < 1e-3 and bar_z0 - 1e-3 < p.z < bar_z1 + 1e-3 for p in pts):
        mk.Add(bar_fil_r2, e.wrapped)
mk.Build()
body = cq.Workplane().add(cq.Shape.cast(mk.Shape()))


def fil_section(w, rho, s, zb, t, r):
    # 2D fillet section in (radial, z): corner at (rho, zb), bar side s, plane side t, radius r
    return (w.moveTo(rho, zb).lineTo(rho + s * r, zb)
            .threePointArc((rho + s * r - s * r * math.sqrt(0.5), zb + t * r - t * r * math.sqrt(0.5)), (rho, zb + t * r))
            .close())


def wedge(c, a0, a1, R=60.0):
    n = 8
    pts = [c] + [(c[0] + R * math.cos(a0 + (a1 - a0) * i / n), c[1] + R * math.sin(a0 + (a1 - a0) * i / n)) for i in range(n + 1)]
    return cq.Workplane("XY", origin=(0, 0, 80)).polyline(pts).close().extrude(40)


def arc_fillet(c, R, s, a0, a1, r=bar_fil_r):
    ring = None
    for zb, t in ((bar_z1, 1), (bar_z0, -1)):
        sec = fil_section(cq.Workplane("XZ"), R, s, zb, t, r)
        piece = sec.revolve(360, (0, 0, 0), (0, 1, 0))
        ring = piece if ring is None else ring.union(piece)
    lo, hi = min(a0, a1), max(a0, a1)
    return ring.translate((c[0], c[1], 0)).intersect(wedge(c, lo, hi))


def line_fillet(x, y0, y1, s, r=bar_fil_r):
    out = None
    for zb, t in ((bar_z1, 1), (bar_z0, -1)):
        piece = fil_section(cq.Workplane("XZ", origin=(0, y1, 0)), x, s, zb, t, r).extrude(y1 - y0)
        out = piece if out is None else out.union(piece)
    return out


blend = arc_fillet(vc, s_vr, 1, 0.0, ang, bar_fil_r2)
blend = blend.union(arc_fillet(s_cc, s_cr, -1, ang + math.pi, math.pi))
blend = blend.union(line_fillet(xp1c, s_cc[1], out_cy, 1))
blend = blend.union(arc_fillet((out_cx, out_cy), out_r, 1, 0.0, math.pi / 2))
body = body.union(blend.intersect(bar_xy))

# --- horn pads: cones from the horn face, continued edge_r into the plate so they fill the
# plate edge round under the pad, clipped to the plate outline ---------------------------
pad_h = xp0 - x_horn
pad_k = (pad_r1 - pad_r0) / pad_h
xpad = cq.Solid.makeCone(pad_r1 + pad_k * edge_r, pad_r0, pad_h + edge_r, cq.Vector(xp0 + edge_r, xa_y, ya_z), cq.Vector(-1, 0, 0))
ypad = cq.Solid.makeCone(pad_r1 + pad_k * edge_r, pad_r0, pad_h + edge_r, cq.Vector(ya_x, yp1 - edge_r, ya_z), cq.Vector(0, 1, 0))
body = body.union(cq.Workplane().add(xpad).intersect(xstad)).union(cq.Workplane().add(ypad).intersect(ystad))

# --- horn holes -----------------------------------------------------------------------
xpts = [(xa_y + bolt_r, ya_z), (xa_y - bolt_r, ya_z), (xa_y, ya_z + bolt_r), (xa_y, ya_z - bolt_r)]
ypts = [(ya_x + bolt_r, ya_z), (ya_x - bolt_r, ya_z), (ya_x, ya_z + bolt_r), (ya_x, ya_z - bolt_r)]
body = body.cut(cq.Workplane("YZ", origin=(x_horn - 1, 0, 0)).center(xa_y, ya_z).circle(rec_r).extrude(rec_d + 1))
body = body.cut(cq.Workplane("YZ", origin=(x_horn - 1, 0, 0)).pushPoints(xpts).circle(hole_r).extrude(12))
body = body.cut(cq.Workplane("YZ", origin=(x_cb, 0, 0)).pushPoints(xpts).circle(cb_r).extrude(8))
# XZ workplane normal is -Y: start beyond the horn face and cut toward -Y
body = body.cut(cq.Workplane("XZ", origin=(0, y_horn + 1, 0)).center(ya_x, ya_z).circle(rec_r).extrude(rec_d + 1))
body = body.cut(cq.Workplane("XZ", origin=(0, y_horn + 1, 0)).pushPoints(ypts).circle(hole_r).extrude(10))
body = body.cut(cq.Workplane("XZ", origin=(0, y_cb, 0)).pushPoints(ypts).circle(cb_r).extrude(5))

if SIDE < 0:
    body = body.mirror("XZ")
from steve import Model

# Rigid print: provisional PLA library properties; existing local profile uses Bambu PLA Matte.
model = Model()
model.add("printed_body", body)
model.material("pla", color="#8a8a90")
result = model.result()
